Data & Method — how each field is calculated / sourced
  • Faith / Tradition / Type: machine classification (CFTLM taxonomy; name + geography + AI-verified).
  • Address: geocoded from the site's GPS (Nominatim / Mapbox / Foursquare). Street View link opens at the site coordinates.
  • Opened / Built: building year from county assessor / parcel records (e.g. FL DOR, TN CAMA, WI, Toronto 3D Massing) or other sources; opened_year uses the building date as a proxy for when the site opened.
  • SqFt: building area from assessor / parcel or building-footprint records — estimated where derived from footprints/massing.
  • Capacity: calculated estimate — building area ÷ ~15 sq ft per person.
  • Pop 15km: computed population within a 15 km radius (gridded census / raster).
  • Fire / Police / Hospital km: computed straight-line distance to the nearest facility from OpenStreetMap (OSM).
  • Coverage (0-6): count of 6 enrichment layers present for the record — a data-richness signal, not an accuracy score.
  • Status: active / closed / historic (Overture operating status, Google Places, historic records).
  • Source: origin dataset for the record (OSM, Holy Sites, Overture, IRS, etc.).
  • Confidence: machine classifier confidence score.
